levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الملك بن أبي الشوارب

notes: Two routes joined by «ح» meet at Hudin (حضين بن المنذر), and the saying is written once after them, so «علي» is the shared tail for both groups
«علي» in «لعلي دونك» is Uthman's address and is scene; the last link is Ali, who speaks «وقال جلد رسول الله» (rule 6, as Uthman in the Hani example)
The surface «علي» also occurs inside «ابن علية»; the third occurrence is the speaker
The two Hudin surfaces are kept as written and not merged
